verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
When the heaven is cleft asunder,
And when the stars are scattered,
And when the rivers are made to flow forth into canals,
w: are made to flow forth into canals

verses.en: And when the graves are laid open,
Each soul shall then know what it has sent forth and what it has held back.
w: and what it has held back

verses.ar: یٰۤاَیُّہَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ مَا غَرَّکَ بِرَبِّکَ الۡکَرِیۡمِ ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: O man, what has emboldened thee against thy Gracious Lord,
Who created thee, then perfected thee, then proportioned thee aright?

verses.ar: فِیۡۤ اَیِّ صُوۡرَۃٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَکَّبَکَ ؕ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: In whatever form He pleased, He fashioned thee.
Nay, but you deny the Judgment.
But there are guardians over you
Honoured recorders,
Who know all that you do.
Verily, the virtuous will be in bliss;
And the wicked will be in Hell;
They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment;
And they will not be able to escape therefrom.
And what should make thee know what the Day of Judgment is!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَاۤ اَدۡرٰٮکَ مَا یَوۡمُ الدِّیۡنِ ﴿ؕ۱۹﴾
verses.en: Again, what should make thee know what the Day of Judgment is!

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِکُ نَفۡسٌ لِّنَفۡسٍ شَیۡئًا ؕ وَالۡاَمۡرُ یَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلّٰہِ ﴿٪۲۰﴾
verses.en: The day when a soul shall have no power to do aught for another soul! And the command on that day will be Allah’s.
